$Comment: What a titan's usable blocks point their Use interaction at. Every fixture on every titan shares this one entry, because what a fixture does depends on which fixture it is, and that is decided by the component on the voxel rather than by the asset: one root interaction here, one system reading TitanFixtureComponent there.
The chain itself does nothing — see Titan_Fixture_Noop for why it has to exist at all.
